comment: ANCHOR: REPRICER_DRY_RUN_20261107 — 2026-11-07 LQ-20261107-01, portfolio-repricer's n8n cutover dry run.
Pins that `scripts/portfolio_repricer.py --dry-run` is write-free: byte+mtime snapshot unchanged, raising
spies on the holdings write lock, atomic_write_bytes, the ticker snapshot, ticker_prices sync, the
watchlist-membership sync and the lane receipt; one LaneOutput@v1 line (mode dry_run, produced 0). Includes
a fail-on-old control (a real pass with the same fixture must write, or the no-change assertions are
vacuous) and the data-broker-record regression found by the first live dry run (KeyError('analyst') on a
quote record that omits the optional Finviz fields). Hermetic: tmp state root, stubbed providers, no DB.
